name: gb_g1_ch1_English_seg1

header.subject: English
header.title: Unit opener and Getting Started: look and say names, initial sounds
header.goal: Children say the name of a picture and its first sound.

moves.do: Point to A, B, C on p.1; the class calls each letter name.
moves.how: Board words stay up all lesson.

moves.do: Hold up p.1, then p.2; ask See, Think, Wonder.
moves.how: Children say “I see …”. Board two answers.
moves.say: “We name each picture and hear its first sound.”

moves.do: Say cat slowly, then only its first sound. Do hen the same.
moves.say: “c … at. I say only the start: /k/. Fatima, how did you find it?”
moves.think: I say cat slowly, c … at. I listen to the very start. I hear /k/. I do not say “at”, only /k/.

moves.do: Name the other seven pictures; class says the first sound.
moves.how: Class says each word slowly first. Ask a home word with /s/.

moves.do: One book open at p.2; A hides a picture, B finds it. One minute.
moves.how: Ahmed and Fatima show it first. A gives the sound; B points, names.
moves.say: “I am thinking of a picture. Its first sound is …”

turn.a: Its first sound is /t/. What is my picture?
turn.b: Is it the top? Say top slowly, /t/.
turn.help: Say the sound again slowly; they point.

moves.do: Finger on p.2; speak quietly, no writing. Items 1-5.
moves.how: 1 pictures, last first · 2 same-sound pair · 3 flowerpot · 4 five colours · 5 home word. Done? Find /b/ /d/ /s/ things.
moves.say: “Fatima says flowerpot, Ahmed says pot. Why does the book say pot?”

answers: any five, e.g. the desk is brown
sections.mistake: Says the end (“at”). Ask: “Say it slowly. What do you hear first?”
sections.stuck: Say it slowly with them; tap a finger for the start.

moves.do: Class reads the success line; then set the bag task.
moves.how: Five children answer alone and aloud, one by one.

sections.success: I can say a picture's name and its first sound.
sections.ask: How did you find the first sound of bag?
sections.listen: I said it slowly, b … ag, and heard only the start.

moves.do: Find three home things; say each first sound.
moves.how: Tell your family, e.g. cup /k/, door /d/.

expect.html:
GRADE 1 · ENGLISH · Ch.1 Time to RecallDay 1 · 40 min

Unit opener and Getting Started: look and say names, initial sounds

Children say the name of a picture and its first sound.
Bringtextbook pp.1-2 · chalk · books, pencils Wordscat · hen · pot · hat · net · sun · top · bed
PRACTICE · 24 of 40 min
5′ 8′ 12′ 12′ 3′
OpenExplainWe DoYou Do✓
★ Your one thing today · in move

Opening

0–5′Full details ›
1

Point to A, B, C on p.1; the class calls each letter name. Board words stay up all lesson. “What letter?” → “A … B … C.”

2

Hold up p.1, then p.2; ask See, Think, Wonder. Children say “I see …”. Board two answers. “We name each picture and hear its first sound.”

Explanation · I Do

5–13′Full details ›
3

Say cat slowly, then only its first sound. Do hen the same. Cover “at”: /k/. Class: “cat, /k/”. “c … at. I say only the start: /k/. Fatima, how did you find it?”Think aloud: “I say cat slowly, c … at. I listen to the very start. I hear /k/. I do not say “at”, only /k/.”

We Do

13–25′Full details ›
4

I START, YOU FINISH
Name the other seven pictures; class says the first sound. Class says each word slowly first. Ask a home word with /s/. “Hat. First sound …” → “/h/.” “Home word with /s/?”

5

ONE NEIGHBOUR TURN
One book open at p.2; A hides a picture, B finds it. One minute. Ahmed and Fatima show it first. A gives the sound; B points, names. “I am thinking of a picture. Its first sound is …”Window side first: “Its first sound is /t/. What is my picture?” → Reply: “Is it the top? Say top slowly, /t/.” · Stop: two claps, finger on lips · Stuck? Say the sound again slowly; they point.

You Do · in the book

25–37′Full details ›
6

⏱ 25′ stop explaining
Finger on p.2; speak quietly, no writing. Items 1-5. 1 pictures, last first · 2 same-sound pair · 3 flowerpot · 4 five colours · 5 home word. Done? Find /b/ /d/ /s/ things. “Fatima says flowerpot, Ahmed says pot. Why does the book say pot?”If stuck: Say it slowly with them; tap a finger for the start.

Check 5 books · answers

1.bed /b/, top /t/, sun /s/ … cat /k/
2.hen and hat: /h/
3.the book teaches /p/
4.any five, e.g. the desk is brown
5.any real thing, right sound

Likely mistake

Says the end (“at”). Ask: “Say it slowly. What do you hear first?”

THE BOARD BY THE END · eight pictures, eight first sounds

Check · exit ticket

37–40′Full details ›
7

Class reads the success line; then set the bag task. Five children answer alone and aloud, one by one. “Say bag slowly. First sound?”Ask: “How did you find the first sound of bag?” → Listen for: I said it slowly, b … ag, and heard only the start.Success: “I can say a picture's name and its first sound.” 👍 or ✊ firstCorrect: /b/, and bag starts like bed.

Homework

at homeFull details ›
8

Find three home things; say each first sound. Tell your family, e.g. cup /k/, door /d/. “Which thing did you find first?”

Full lesson plan ›
